additions.site_name: Dummerstorf Gewerbe- und Logistikzentrum Ostsee 3.0 Data Centre Site
additions.name: Rechenzentrum Dummerstorf (Giga-Factory) — planned large data centre in B-Plan Nr. 25b „Gewerbe- und Logistikzentrum Ostsee 3.0“ (1. Änderung)

status.summary: The Gemeinde Dummerstorf's official notice of 14 October 2026 announces the early public participation for the 1st amendment of Bebauungsplan Nr. 25b „Gewerbe- und Logistikzentrum Ostsee 3.0“, whose stated aim is to create the concrete settlement conditions for a large data centre (Giga-Factory) that would need almost the whole plan area; the Gemeindevertretung approved the preliminary draft on 22 September 2026 and the documents are on display from 29 October to 30 November 2026. This establishes an announced data-centre project at a defined plan area as of the notice date. It is a draft land-use plan amendment: no building permit, BImSchG permit, grid connection or physical work is established, and the notice states no developer, operator, capacity or schedule.

locator.precision: Area centroid of the 'Geltungsbereich der 1. Änderung' of B-Plan Nr. 25b (about 38.6 ha, about 840 m by 640 m) as outlined on the Gemeinde's Übersichtsplan of 14 October 2026 and registered to the BKG basemap.de web raster. It locates the planning area that the Gemeinde says the data centre would almost entirely occupy; it does not locate a building, data hall, substation, entrance or surveyed plot boundary, and it excludes the access strip to the L191 that belongs only to the original plan.
locator.identity_review: The notice's annexed Übersichtsplan outlines the 1st-amendment area north-west of Dummerstorf village, south of the A20 and west of the existing logistics buildings of the 'Gewerbe- und Logistikzentrum Ostsee'; the in-force B-Plan Nr. 25b justification (2022) describes the same 46.5 ha plan area bounded by B-Plan 25a, the Liepgraben lowland and the L191. The outline was traced from the notice's embedded 604 x 500 pixel map and registered to basemap.de (EPSG:25833) with a seven-point affine fit on road features (Kreuz Rostock, A20 and A19 junctions, L39/L191 crossings and roundabouts): RMS 6.8 m, maximum residual 10.1 m, maximum leave-one-out error 38.2 m. On basemap.de the registered outline lies in the open field west of the Gewerbepark Ostsee road (its south-east edge follows that road) and south of the Liepgraben woodland, and the diagonal field track of the B-Plan 25b Planzeichnung crosses it in the same direction (geometry facts). No ALKIS-MV parcel geometry was used: the MV geodata hosts returned HTTP 503 for robots.txt and were not accessed. The village centre, the Amazon logistics-centre address and the wider 120 ha industrial-park extent are excluded.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The Übersichtsplan prints no coordinates, grid or datum and has about 5.4 m per pixel; registration residuals (RMS 6.8 m, leave-one-out up to 38.2 m) measure only map-to-reference consistency, and tracing adds about 5-11 m per vertex. The point is the centroid of a 38.6 ha planning area whose vertices lie up to 474 m away, and the data-centre buildings' positions are not published.

additions.distinctness_review: Screened on 27 October 2026 (Dummerstorf, Kavelstorf, Ostsee 3.0, B-Plan 25b, Gewerbe- und Logistikzentrum Ostsee, Giga-Factory/Gigafactory, Rostock, Schwarz Digits, STACKIT) against sites.csv, projects.csv, evidence.csv, source-records.json and identity-mapping.json of verified_construction_core/2026-10-27-research-hundredfirst (834 sites, 900 projects, 4,714 evidence rows; first screened against 2026-10-27-research-hundredth), every queue fragment's changes.json and holds.json, queue/claims.tsv and every sources/*holds*.json file. No Atlas site, project, pending addition or claim lies within 2 km; the nearest Atlas site is DVZ Schwerin Lübecker Straße Campus (68.7 km). The only Schwarz Digits record in the Atlas is the Lübbenau campus in Brandenburg (about 260 km away). Dummerstorf appears only in the thirty-fourth holds (Schwarz Digits Dummerstorf, held for want of a sourced locator) and in the eighty-ninth holds and de-at-ch-p4 holds (as a mention in the STACKIT Ostermiething reason). The Schwarz Gruppe's 27 August 2026 release puts its planned 240 MW data centre on a plot 'in the Gewerbegebiet of the Gemeinde Dummerstorf'; the Gemeinde's notice does not name the developer, so this record is not attributed to the Schwarz group and no owner or operator role is asserted, but it is very probably the same project (one large data centre per notice in the same municipality, plan approved 26 days after the release): a later Schwarz or Gemeinde record naming B-Plan 25b would confirm it, and the thirty-fourth hold should then be treated as resolved by this record rather than admitted separately.
additions.successor_review: Checked on 27 October 2026: the Gemeinde's notice list shows no later notice on B-Plan 25b (the early participation starts on 29 October 2026); the Gemeinde's Bebauungspläne page still lists only the in-force B-Plan 25b documents; the state planning portal bauportal-mv.de lists no Dummerstorf data-centre plan in its municipal list (the Vorentwurf is to appear there from 29 October). The Gemeinde's council information system (dummerstorf.sitzung-mv.de) disallows Anthropic agents in robots.txt and was not read. No permit, construction start, withdrawal or pause was found, so announced as of 14 October 2026 is kept.

status.summary: Green Mountain's FRA-Mainz page, as published on 12 October 2026 (Internet Archive raw copy of that day; the page was last revised on 6 October 2026), describes FRA-Mainz as a 'New sustainable data center under construction near Frankfurt', labels it 'Under construction' in the site menu and says Green Mountain 'operates five data centers, plus one under construction'. This refreshes the record's under-construction observation of 21 July 2026 with the operator's own current statement. It keeps the record's scope (the three-building, 54 MW FRA-Mainz development with KMW); the Q4 2026 ready-for-service date is a forecast, and no completion, commissioning, energisation or operation is inferred.

status_updates.identity_review: The archived page is Green Mountain's own FRA-Mainz project page at the same URL that supplied the record's 21 July 2026 status (greenmountain.no/data-center/fra-mainz/), and it describes the same project: the Green Mountain and KMW joint venture building a three-building, 54 MW data-centre site near Frankfurt in Mainz with Rhine-water cooling and gas-turbine emergency power from the KMW campus. The existing record 'Green Mountain FRA-Mainz Current Three-Building Development' (site curated:green-mountain-fra-mainz-campus, Energieatlas Green Rocks project point at Gaßnerallee) is that development, so the refresh keeps the project, scope and locator unchanged.
status_updates.successor_review: Strictly newer than the existing 21 July 2026 observation. Checked on 27 October 2026: the live page carries the same 6 October 2026 revision and still says under construction; Green Mountain's news sitemap (items to 19 October 2026) and data-centre sitemap contain no FRA-Mainz completion, opening, pause or cancellation; the Atlas holds no other FRA-Mainz project and no pending queue fragment changes it. under_construction as of 12 October 2026 is kept; Q4 2026 ready for service is not treated as achieved.
